> This file is generated by Boris from a validated Trunk/Satellite content graph.

## Documentation

- [Boris on ATProto](/index.html): This is an **all-around help area for Boris** — the Zig content compiler — and the **AT Protocol** surface it publishes to. It is also a living demo: every page here is compiled by Boris itself, the whole site projects onto the `standar
  - [The AT Protocol](/atproto.html): The **AT Protocol** \(ATProto\) is a decentralized networking protocol for social applications. It provides portable identity, interoperation between services, and a shared data model so that content and relationships are not siloed per app. 
  - [Boris](/boris.html): **Boris** is a single native binary — a content compiler written in Zig \(currently `boris/0.8.1`, built with Zig 0.16.0 for Darwin-arm64\). It takes a directory of Markdown \(or Textile/Cooklang\) and produces, in one pass, a verified static
  - [Getting Started](/guides/getting-started.html): A page is one Markdown file with YAML frontmatter. The frontmatter `id` is derived from the path unless you write one; `title`, `tags`, and `parent` shape the graph. For the big picture of what Boris is, see \[\[boris\]\]; for the ATProto publi
